diagnosis.observed: Packaged Nimbalyst 0.79.1 reports a team-only body write failure in a teamless workspace, after saving local tracker content and body-cache versions.
implementationTrace: MainBodyDocService.resolveBodyRoomIdentity returns null without a workspace team.
initializeHeadlessBodyMarkdown throws when no body-room entry is available.
tracker_create uses the team sharing policy to attempt that room write.
tracker_update reports a failed team body write when applyHeadlessBodyMarkdown returns false under team policy.
The renderer useTrackerContentCollab keeps teamless workspaces on local editing.
diagnosis.constraint: The supported tracker schema handler forbids demoting a team tracker to personal. Do not bypass this by changing the database or schema files directly.
diagnosis.deployment: Installed app is packaged. Editing the separate Nimbalyst checkout would not repair the running app until a separately authorized build/restart.

remaining: A permanent application fix is not implemented. No off-device backup or cloud synchronization is claimed.
